title: UGC agency matching small DTC brands with video creators

source.text: A UGC agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos, 20% commission. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

solution: An agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos
assumptions: Price is a 20% commission on the creator fee, billed to the brand on top of the creator rate
Typical order is a pack of 5 videos at the 2025 Collabstr average paid price of $154 per video
The user's time is valued at $25/hour (estimate) to cost CAC and per-order support
First customers come from cold email/DMs to Shopify brands that run paid social ads
The problem is stated by the reviewer: small DTC brands need a steady flow of ad-ready creator videos
